persistentVolumeClaimName.description: Name of the PersistentVolumeClaim to snapshot.

volumeSnapshotContentName.description: Name of an existing VolumeSnapshotContent to use.

source.description: Source of the snapshot. Set one of `persistentVolumeClaimName` or `volumeSnapshotContentName`.

volumeSnapshotClassName.description: Name of the VolumeSnapshotClass used to create the snapshot.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

enabled.description: Create this volume snapshot when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.
